S040-01.notes: 'first thing visitors notice' = most prominent/salient. Concealed and modest contradict; temporary unsupported. Inserted each choice; only salient works.

S040-02.notes: Almost all films local, one from outside region -> narrow/local = parochial. Eclectic is the opposite; ambitious/controversial not supported by the colon's evidence.

S040-03.notes: Introduces Pando as remarkable single organism, then 'however' describes grazing threat to its renewal. B/C/D describe content not present.

S040-04.notes: Deprived bees still danced (rules out A), improved with practice but distance stayed less accurate (rules out D, and B since distance is affected by observation, not fixed). C is appropriately hedged.

S040-05.notes: Conclusion contrasts frozen (-18C, 95%) vs room temp (20C, 30%); only B cites both conditions. A uses 4C not frozen; C omits room temp; D doesn't show loss of most ability.

flags: minor: D is the longest choice, though the length is substantive (charcoal fading explains why the date implies 79 CE).
S040-06.notes: A mid-October 79 CE inscription made before burial implies the eruption came after mid-October. Consistent with the real 2018 Regio V charcoal inscription finding. A irrelevant to date; B wrong year; C supports the traditional date.

S040-07.notes: Text 2 dates markings to before modern human arrival, so they'd be Neanderthal, countering the claim Neanderthals lacked art/symbolic thought; A preserves the 'if dates hold' hedge. C contradicts Text 2's assumption; B/D contradict it.

S040-08.notes: Only C mentions both limited training (self-taught) and major recognition (Royal Society), joined with concessive 'Although'.

S040-09.notes: Second sentence gives a contrasting drawback to the benefits; 'At the same time' signals a counterpoint. A causal, B example, C summary all fail.

S040-10.notes: Noun needed after 'little' ('had little effect on'); 'affect' as noun is psychology jargon, 'effects' clashes with 'little' (would need 'few'), 'affected' is a verb.
